slice: engine builders and wheel builders (who did the work)
notes: Each entry is what the shop's own page says it offers. Shops are listed without a bike list unless the page names one. Engine builders already on file: Pro Circuit, Twisted Development, Slavens Racing.

products.product: Engine services (CNC head porting, valve jobs, cylinder and crank work)
products.what_it_changes: CNC head porting with a valve job, 3- or 5-angle valve jobs, seat and guide replacement, cylinder decking, boring and honing, crank rebuilding and truing, dyno tuning and ignition mapping.
products.notes: Send components only (head, cylinder, crank), not a complete engine; complete builds go through the shop's listed service centers. Corona, California. Race use only.

products.product: Race engine builds, rebuilds and cylinder porting
products.what_it_changes: Full race engine builds and rebuilds, two- and four-stroke porting, copper valve seat installation, crankshaft balancing, transmission finishing, engine coatings and in-house dyno tuning.
products.notes: Murrieta, California. The services page names no bike list.

products.product: Two- and four-stroke engine building, porting and head work
products.what_it_changes: Two- and four-stroke engine building, cylinder porting, head modification and four-stroke head porting with valve seat re-cutting, case matching, crankshaft rebuilds, big-bore and stroker builds including supermini sizes.
products.notes: Hesperia, California. Building engines since 1979 per the shop's page. No bike list published.

products.product: Wheel rebuilds and custom wheel builds
products.what_it_changes: Rebuilds a rider's own hubs with new rims and stainless spokes, replaces bearings and seals, refinishes hubs, and builds custom wheelsets on Talon, Kite or Haan hubs with Excel or D.I.D rims.
products.notes: Orange, California. Rebuilds are offered for any year, make or model. Rebuild pricing is listed from $800 with new rims, spokes and labor (checked 2026-11-20).

products.what_it_changes: Repairs spokes, hubs and rotors, straightens bent rims, and builds a wheel from parts the rider supplies.
products.price: Repair $60, rim straightening $100, build from your parts $60 a wheel (Warp 9, 2026-11-20)
products.notes: Salt Lake City, Utah. A repair form and return number are needed before shipping; the rider pays shipping both ways. The page does not say whether repairs are limited to the maker's own wheels.
